intervention_description: Patients whose final 3-year ICD-10 research diagnosis was schizophrenia (first-episode schizophrenia, FES), among the 420 who completed 3-year follow-up. A post-hoc diagnostic split of one recruited sample, so `subgroup` rather than a separate cohort: the split is made at 3 years on the longitudinal course, not at recruitment.

Patients whose final 3-year ICD-10 research diagnosis was mania with psychotic features (first-episode mania with psychotic features, FEMP), among the 420 who completed 3-year follow-up. Post-hoc diagnostic split of the same recruited sample as arm `fes`.
